questions: What does resolve_channels() do with poll_pid set? Does it guarantee chan_count >= 1 when poll_pid is non-zero?
Is t->chans[0] always valid for poll_pid requests, or should the channel be selected based on the poll PID like the old code did?
Are there race conditions on t->sched, t->chans, or t->poll_pid accessed from multiple threads?
Is the 6-byte buffer in build_mode01_request sufficient for CAN-FD (64+ byte frames)?
